subject: Last-mile incentive request for Pinecrest pilot conversion
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@pinecrest.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot wrap: proposal & last-mile incentive

Hi Alex —

Great talking this morning. Based on the usage profile you shared, we think Pinecrest is in a good spot to convert the pilot into a paid subscription with predictable throughput. To help you cross the internal approval bar and accelerate procurement, we can offer a one-time conversion sweetener: 75k token credit (applies to hosted usage) plus a 60-day trial-extension on Redwood Dedicated for the first month after signing.

Summary of the ask:
- Incentive: 75k token credit (non-refundable, applied to first invoice).
- Trial extension: 60 days of Dedicated trial access for the same environment you’ve been using.
- Conditions: usage cap of $10k/month after credits expire; auto-renew turned off by default; offer valid if signed and PO received by 2026-11-18.

I attached an updated proposal with the incentive baked in (Proposal_v2.pdf) and a redlined SOW for your procurement team’s review. If this looks acceptable, I need quick approve from my manager to finalize. Can you confirm procurement’s timeline for PO / SOW signoff?

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: 415-555-0182

Attachment: Proposal_v2.pdf (updated pricing + incentive summary)
Attachment: SOW_redlined.docx
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@pinecrest.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pinecrest.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: proposal & last-mile incentive

Thanks, Evelyn — appreciate the clear summary. Procurement will need:
- Written confirmation of the credit amount and how it will appear on invoices,
- Confirmation that the trial extension does not include elevation of access beyond the pilot environment (no production migration until contract).
- A redlined SOW (we received SOW_redlined.docx) and the final pricing table in the proposal.

Our timeline: procurement review and PO can be completed by 2026-11-17 if we have a final SOW and a formal confirmation of the incentive terms by EOD 2026-11-10. Otherwise it slips to the next finance cycle.

One additional question: is data residency still limited to us-west-2 for Dedicated trials? We need that spelled out for our security review.

Regards,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Partnerships | Pinecrest AI
alex.johnson@pinecrest.ai
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-03T12:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap: proposal & last-mile incentive — approval needed

Markus / Ben — looping you in for manager approval to lock the incentive for Pinecrest. Key ask: authorize a one-time 75k token credit + 60-day Dedicated trial extension, conditioned on PO by 2026-11-18 and the usage cap noted below.

Why: strong usage during pilot (avg 12k tokens/day), high likelihood to expand to multi-team. Closing this quarter keeps the ARR motion in Q4 and avoids multicycle procurement delays.

Proposed guardrails:
- Credit applied as a line-item adjustment on first invoice; expires if not used within 90 days of invoice date.
- Dedicated trial: same region (us-west-2) only; no production migration without separate contract amendment.
- Usage cap enforcement: after credits are exhausted, throttle at $10k/month until contract conversion.
- Legal / Finance to sign off on the SOW redlines and DocuSign.

Attached: Proposal_v2.pdf, SOW_redlined.docx. If approved, Ben can finalize the DocuSign envelope and I’ll coordinate signature with Alex.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Evelyn — thanks for the clear write-up. Approve the incentive with the following explicit constraints:
1) Cap the total promotional hit to Redwood to $15k USD budgeted for Q4 (finance will invoice to track the expense).
2) Credits are to be represented as a single line-item "Promotional Credit" on the first invoice; clarify expiration in the doc (90 days).
3) Dedicated trial extension is allowed but must be explicitly limited to us-west-2 and the pilot environment; no HA/production add-ons.
4) Security / Compliance: include a sentence in the SOW stating data residency remains us-west-2 and logs/audit retention follow standard Redwood policy.

Ben — please coordinate DocuSign and route the final envelope to Legal and Finance (cc: me) for counter-signature. Once procurement confirms PO by 2026-11-17 we can execute.

I want the offer to include an auto-expire clause (offer void after 2026-11-18) and a hard usage cap that triggers an invoice if exceeded. Otherwise go ahead.

-Markus Klein
